paragraphs: Taal turns a write-off forecast into a human-approved play (a transfer, an offer or both). The agent is refused by code until its play carries a holdout; code assigns the groups, and the app says plainly when the result has not proved anything yet.

For a dark-store team clearing a lot before its online sell-by: on the live Desk, 103 packs of Darjeeling Tea, 24 days left, ₹35,020 at stake. Forecast, Propose, Approve, Offer, Measure. Retail & Commerce, AI Builder Cup 2026.

Why us. We are in a category team at Supertails, an Indian pet-care e-commerce company: Nandish on pricing, Rinu on online sales and part of the P&L. Near-expiry and slow-moving stock is a standing cost: written off, or tying up storage and capital. Phase 1 is near-expiry stock; phase 2, slow-moving SKUs. Taal has not been used at Supertails; all data is synthetic.
features: No play without a holdout, enforced in code. ruleholdoutrequired rejects a play without a holdout fraction of 5 to 90%, a minimum treated count and a seed (agents/gate/guardrails.py:161-172); code then sets the seed and…

It says when nothing is proved yet. A holdout interval that crosses zero reads INCONCLUSIVE, labelled SYNTHETIC, and the power simulation states the data a real answer needs: about 1,156 customers for a 5 pp lift…

Each safety layer measured on its own. The tool refuses another customer's id in every run although the chat model tries it 3 of 3 times (agents/customer/tools.py:43-59); Model Armor blocks 3 of 8 chat injection cases…
A pre-registered, frozen eval. The protocol was committed before any model call; a run is INVALID if a fallback model answers; the harness enforces a spend cap (eval/adversarial/PROTOCOL.md).

Cite-or-drop that resists tricks. Rationale numbers must match the play in Western or Indian digit grouping (agents/gate/guardrails.py:221-228); copied untrusted phrases are caught after folding look-alike and invisible…
